definition.classification: Post-execution task/evaluator-validity sensitivity audit, discovered from registered regression failures; primary scores remain unchanged.
definition.reason: The task requires exact users/<user>/views/<view> names and returning other collections unchanged. Pristine sidebar-row-state mocks users/1/memoViews/abc and expects the extracted abc. Actual proto/API builders use users/{user}/views/{view}. Restoring that fixture conflicts with the requested strict helper contract even if a candidate updates relevant fixtures.
definition.fixtureChange: Only replace the single mock resource name. All test logic/assertions stay byte-for-byte otherwise unchanged.
definition.candidates: Baseline plus all four memoViewNames candidates; no selection by result. No application patch edits or new coding calls.
definition.scope: Targeted UI fixture sensitivity only, not a repeat of the entire regression suite or replacement primary endpoint. Genuine formatter or candidate-test failures remain failures.
